title: Intermediate motivation record (pipeline)
description: A chapter opener or end-of-chapter bridge. Generated from outlines (NOT scraped). The `block` payload is a valid ChapterData block (callout|paragraph) insertable verbatim into src/chapters/<id>/index.ts sections. No license/attribution needed — original copy.

nextChapterId.description: For bridges: the chapter the cliffhanger points to. null for the final chapter (points outward).

placement.description: Where the merge step inserts the block. opener→first; bridge→last.

block.description: A ChapterData block. Bilingual text required.

text.description: May contain [[term-id|display]] links (validated) and inline $...$ LaTeX (validated).
